author: bardic-inspiration
name: Flash Powder
summary: A small packet that bursts with blinding light when thrown.
description: Stage magicians use it, and pickpockets use it more. The packet is stamped with a sunburst.

stats.effect: As a Bonus Action, you can throw this packet at a point within 20 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the {ref:condition/blinded} condition until the end of its next turn. The packet is consumed.
